content.value: A RCC slab of 15'X15’ is to be supported by two square tied columns designated as column-A and column-B. The slab having a thickness of 5 inch has to carry a service live load of 65 psf in addition with its self-weight. The design specification required that 2/3 of the slab load is to be carried by column-A. Design column-A using fc’=3500psi and fy =50000psi. Follow USD method.
